Moesha finds her history teacher’s remarks racially offensive, but fears that confronting him might affect her grade and cost Niecy her scholarship.

A well-intentioned Moesha intervenes to try and stop her once-popular hangout, The Den, from being sold to a commercial developer, unaware that Andell stands to make a great deal of money on its sale.

Hakeem and Moesha’s friendship takes an interesting turn after he surprises her with an expensive necklace to wear to a homecoming dance she’s attending with someone else.

Dorian pulls an illegal scam involving Frank’s credit card and makes matters worse by lying about it, behavior that could have dramatic consequences.

title: Moesha

With Dee sick in bed with a bad cold, Moesha offers to prepare the Thanksgiving feast but finds herself engaged in a fierce cooking competition with Hakeem’s mother.

Moesha starts having recurring romantic dreams about Hakeem, giving her second thoughts about their friendship and about sharing a room with him and Niecy on an upcoming ski trip.

title: Moesha
description:

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E19 — Everybody Hates Back Talk
Chris decides to take a stand against his mother, Rochelle and refuses to do his household chores, causing Rochelle to complain to Julius that her son is disrespecting her.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E20 — Everybody Hates Tasha
Chris works up the courage to ask Tasha to be his girlfriend and is surprised when she accepts. Unfortunately, Chris had no clue that being a boyfriend entailed giving up all his free time and only doing things that Tasha wants to do.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E21 — Everybody Hates Spring Break
Chris accidentally hits Greg while test driving the janitor's car, landing Greg in the hospital with a broken leg. Meanwhile, with both of Greg's parents out of town, Rochelle decides to skip the family vacation so she can take care of Greg.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:

During the last week of school, Chris is informed that if he gets one more tardy he will have to repeat the 10th grade.

title: Half & Half
description:

After telling Mona not to let people take advantage of her, Dee Dee later regrets giving her that advice when she asks Mona a favor and is turned down.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E19 — The Big Who's Wooing Who? Episode
When Mona is courted and gets a job offer from another record label, she has to make a choice between staying at Delicious Records or moving on. Meanwhile, in order to keep up with the Jones’, Big Dee Dee plans an extravagant birthday party for Drew.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E20 — The Big Mother For Others Episode
When Big Dee Dee crashes in on Phyllis’ Charity telethon meeting, Phyllis loses it and reveals to everyone that Big Dee Dee was pregnant before she married Charles. Meanwhile, Mona confronts Phyllis about her annoying habit of making blunt comments.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E21 — The Big Thorne In My Side Episode
When Phyllis gets into trouble with her Homeowner's Association, Dee Dee comes to her defense, but ends up causing more harm than good.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

description:

Mark injures himself while performing a story for his substitute first-grade class, including Michelle Tanner (MARY KATE/ASHLEY OLSEN). Afterward, Mark is too embarrassed to keep his date with a beautiful woman (GALYN GORG).

description:

Mark's ex-girlfriend, Paula (LELA ROCHON), moves back into town and revives their passionate romance.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark helps a student basketball player (CHRISTOPHER CARTER) pass an important algebra test. Chris Tucker guest stars.

description:

When Mark coaches a girls' cheerleading team, he desperately asks Vanessa to help him train the untalented cheerleaders.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

After Mark finally gets a permanent teaching job as a basketball coach, he's offered a contract to play for the Warriors, a professional basketball team. First of a two-part episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark is given a temporary contract to play professional basketball with his favorite team, the Warriors. Unfortunately, Mark must play guard against basketball star Charles Barkley (HIMSELF). Second of a two-part episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark and Robin try to make Andre choose between his interests in basketball and music.
